sections.text:
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 40. Heals HP.
Healing Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Heals 10% of max HP every 5 seconds for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases DEF and MDEF by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases Healing Ability Power by 30% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Reduces ATK and MATK of all enemies by 40% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Removes status ailments from all allies.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the Unison gauge of all allies excluding yourself by 20.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5000
Only [Azure God] Aether can be used as Unlocking Potential material
